title: Kissed Charred Greek Tomato Avgolemono
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Greek dish featuring charred tomatoes and a tangy avgolemono sauce, served in a ceramic tagine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Char the tomatoes over an open flame or in the oven until the skin is blistered and blackened.
Peel the charred tomatoes and puree them in a blender or food processor until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, egg yolks, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm tomato puree into the bowl while continuously whisking.
Stir in the Greek yogurt and minced garlic.
Season the avgolemono sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Pour the sauce into a ceramic tagine and serve hot.
Garnish with additional lemon wedges and a sprinkle of black pepper if desired.
